model.description: R34.1 (R-A A1). The universal «◆ Scenario» + «✎ Edit» default actions HANDLER in the shared drawer: on rb-drawer-action, Scenario → /scenario?ior=<uuid> focused view, Edit → scenarioEditorHref(uuid). Generic (no host needed), works on every detail. ALREADY BUILT + LIVE v0.8.43 (f28939b41, unified with R34.7/R-E). The verb-LISTING rides actionsForContext (a1a5be99); the default-PAIR composition [Scenario,Edit] lives in RbDetailDrawer.universalActionBar (ffd44b17, R34.7 shared mechanism — crossRef, NOT double-marked). THIS chain credits the HANDLER (onUniversalAction). Client-only.
